mapper.sql: j.id, j.job_name, j.plugin_installation_id, i.plugin_id, d.display_name AS plugin_display_name, j.cron_expression, j.job_status, j.misfire_policy, j.concurrent, j.input_json, j.timeout_millis, j.executed_status, j.remark, j.owner_user_id, u.username AS owner_username, j.owner_dept_id AS owner_department_id, dept.department_name AS owner_department_name, j.created_by, j.updated_by, j.created_at, j.updated_at

FROM job j JOIN plugin_installation i ON i.installation_id = j.plugin_installation_id JOIN plugin_definition d ON d.plugin_id = i.plugin_id LEFT JOIN sky_user u ON u.user_id = j.owner_user_id JOIN sky_department dept ON dept.department_id = j.owner_dept_id
mapper.update: UPDATE job SET job_name = #{jobName}, plugin_installation_id = #{pluginInstallationId}, cron_expression = #{cronExpression}, misfire_policy = #{misfirePolicy}, concurrent = #{concurrent}, input_json = CAST(#{inputJson} AS JSON), timeout_millis = #{timeoutMillis}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY j.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job WHERE plugin_installation_id = #{pluginInstallationId}

SELECT j.job_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS total
GROUP BY j.job_status

SELECT j.executed_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS total
GROUP BY j.executed_status
mapper.update: UPDATE job SET job_status = #{status}, updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE job SET executed_status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE job SET executed_status = #{runningStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND executed_status = #{idleStatus}
UPDATE job SET executed_status = #{idleStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND executed_status = #{runningStatus}
UPDATE job SET executed_status = #{idleStatus} WHERE executed_status = #{runningStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE j.job_status = #{enabledStatus} ORDER BY j.id
